items: An **enum** is a fixed set of constants; invalid values become **compile errors** rather than run-time surprises.
**`==` is correct for enums**; `<` and `>` are not. Use `compareTo()` for ordering.
`valueOf()` is case-sensitive and throws `IllegalArgumentException`, **always guard user input**.
In a switch on an enum, case labels are **unqualified**.
Enums can carry **fields, constructors, and methods**: usually better than a switch elsewhere.
**Nested classes** come in four kinds; nest only when the class is an implementation detail of its container.
